name: [Addon Repository] Reliability, documentation, monitoring
description:
## Summary

Addon Repository is the deployment pipeline for partner frontend addons. It serves **58 addon repositories running on 6,191 live production e-shops**. The addons billed on a recurring subscription generate **CZK 62,623/month for Shoptet** after partner commissions — **CZK 751,484/year** — out of CZK 302,512/month gross billed to merchants. The pipeline today runs on Vercel, outside Shoptet infrastructure, with no monitoring, no regression coverage of the deploy flow, and no partner-facing documentation for safe testing and deployment. This epic moves the pipeline onto Shoptet infrastructure, adds monitoring and regression tests, puts security maintenance on a regular footing, and documents the deploy flow for partners. Migration also removes a USD 240 annual Vercel fee, subject to internal hosting costs.

## Why?

The commercial footprint is larger than the recurring revenue suggests: only 2,525 of the 6,191 live installs sit on recurring-paid addons. The rest run one-off paid addons (3,514 installs) or addons the partner bills directly (79 installs) — neither shows up in recurring revenue, while both depend on the same pipeline. A pipeline that nobody monitors, that has no regression coverage, and whose hosting sits outside Shoptet infrastructure is a single point of failure for partner deployments across all of them.

The revenue above is revenue **directly linked** to these addons, not revenue protected by this work: a deployment outage does not necessarily interrupt existing addon functionality or billing. The case here is deployment reliability and ownership, not revenue at immediate risk.

## What?

The addon deployment pipeline runs on Shoptet infrastructure, is monitored like any other Shoptet service, has regression coverage that catches a broken deploy before a partner does, has a defined security-maintenance routine, and is documented well enough that a partner can test and deploy without a Shoptet engineer in the loop.

## Acceptance Criteria

Addon deployment runs on Shoptet infrastructure; Vercel is decommissioned and the USD 240/year subscription cancelled

Deployment failures raise an alert with a named owner, not a partner report

Regression tests cover the deploy path and run before release

Dependency and secret/token maintenance has a documented owner and cadence

Partners can test and deploy an addon following documentation alone

## Resources

## Technical notes

Revenue is derived from normalized recurring flat fees; partner commission rates come from a local database, so production rates and VAT treatment are unverified. The repository-to-service mapping is a snapshot of `st_api.addon_html_include.repository_url` taken 2026-09-17 and does not auto-update — a newly registered partner repository will not appear in the reporting until the mapping is refreshed. List prices used for the one-off figures are the CZ price list only, so EUR markets are missing.
